run_data_ingestion: run the data ingestion script to load pickled Wikipedia data into a Solr collection in batches
run_load_data: run the load_data function to load pickled processed data from a file path
run_get_data_for_key: run get_data_for_key to extract a Solr document object from title-based Wikipedia and Wikidata info
run_remove_all_docs: run remove_all_docs to delete all documents from the Solr collection using a wildcard query
run_remove_disambiguation_pages: run the script with --remove_disambiguation_pages to filter out Wikipedia disambiguation pages before ingestion
